skills.description: Enforces a single ACTIVE_ROOT (typically one src/) with no nested src/src or duplicate roots; Completeness must fail or auto-remove duplicates.
Builds arc42-aligned C4 Context/Container/Component views as an HTML index site (not Markdown). Use when assembling architecture visualization outputs.

Orchestrator Manager strategy for CSA — bootstraps shared swarm memory, fans out specialist subagents in parallel with per-lane Completeness, thin Assembler packaging, then final pack gate. Use as the primary workflow orchestrator agent.
Shared CSA artifact metadata, ID conventions, confidence scoring, and evidence reference rules. Use when producing or validating any CSA specialist artifact JSON.
Extract DDD domains, entities, business rules, and capabilities from legacy code for CSA. Use when Manager invokes Business Domain analysis.
Per-lane CSA gate checker; after join, renders lean csa_pack from artifacts and validates it. Replaces Document Assembler.
Field-level and entity-level data lineage for legacy CSA. Use when Manager invokes Data Lineage analysis.
Technology inventory and artifact classification for legacy CSA discovery. Use when the Manager invokes Discover or when classifying a legacy codebase stack, modules, and dependencies.
Thin-packages lean CSA pack (5 Markdown docs + arc42/C4 HTML) from accepted specialist artifacts after per-lane gates. Use when Manager invokes Document Assembler.
Classify legacy integrations (REST/EVENT/BATCH/LEGACY), sync vs async, and resilience patterns for CSA. Use when Manager invokes Integration Analysis.
Enforces deep, long-form CSA specialist JSON and Markdown/HTML pack narratives (reference-quality depth).
HARD CSA swarm control loop — per-lane Completeness, then Completeness renders lean csa_pack from artifacts. No Document Assembler. No duplicate deliverables/machine folders.
Enforces separation of concerns across CSA pack Markdown sections and HTML index to prevent duplicated summaries/evidence dumps.
Shared-memory protocol for CSA Orchestrator swarm — swarm_state, handoffs, context_memory, and artifact index so parallel specialists sync outputs. Use for Manager bootstrap and every subagent turn.
Runtime-aware technical architecture, C4 layers, components, and tech debt for CSA. Use when Manager invokes Technology Architecture analysis.
Standard structure for CSA data architecture and lineage documentation. Use during Data Lineage analysis and Assembler section 06.
DDD structuring for CSA domain model — bounded contexts, aggregates, entities, and business rules as Markdown. Use during Business Domain analysis and Assembler domain docs.
Maps CSA capabilities and traceability into Function, Epic, and Story seeds as Markdown for modernization backlog generation. Use during Document Assembler and epic-story readiness gate.
Rules for citing file paths, line ranges, and artifact kinds on CSA claims. Use when writing specialist artifacts or validating evidence coverage.
Quality gate for CSA domain.json. Use when validating Business Domain specialist output.
Quality gate for assembled csa_pack Markdown sections, arc42-C4 HTML index, and machine artifacts. Use after Document Assembler.
Quality gate for CSA lineage.json. Use when validating Data Lineage specialist output.
Quality gate for CSA discovery.json. Use when Completeness Validator evaluates Discover output.
Final gate ensuring functions/epics/stories Markdown seeds are CSA-traceable before epic generation. Use after epic_story_seeds Markdown files are written.
Quality gate for CSA integration.json. Use when validating Integration specialist output.
Quality gate for CSA architecture.json. Use when validating Tech Architecture specialist output.
Quality gate for TSA target_data.json. Use when Completeness Validator evaluates that artifact.
Quality gate for TSA tsa_pack Markdown + HTML + Mermaid. Use when Completeness Validator evaluates that artifact.
Quality gate for TSA target_domain.json. Use when Completeness Validator evaluates that artifact.
Quality gate for TSA epic_story_seeds Markdown. Use when Completeness Validator evaluates that artifact.
Quality gate for TSA intake.json / stack_decisions. Use when Completeness Validator evaluates that artifact.
Quality gate for TSA target_integration.json. Use when Completeness Validator evaluates that artifact.
Quality gate for TSA migration_strategy.json. Use when Completeness Validator evaluates that artifact.
Quality gate for TSA target_architecture.json. Use when Completeness Validator evaluates that artifact.
Detection heuristics for 20+ year legacy stacks (J2EE, .NET Framework, VB, COBOL, classic ASP, ESB, batch). Use during Discover and when validating stack claims.

Detection heuristics for IBM MQ (native com.ibm.mq and JMS) queue managers, channels, queues, and put/get patterns in legacy Java. Use during Discover and Integration analysis. Do not hardcode customer queue names.

Detection and documentation heuristics for legacy stored procedures, packages, and ORM call sites (PL/SQL, TopLink, iBatis/MyBatis, JDBC CallableStatement). Use during Discover, Domain, Data Lineage, and Completeness validation. Do not hardcode customer package names.

Author and render Mermaid diagrams correctly in CSA Markdown and arc42-C4 HTML. Use whenever Assembler, arc42-c4-views, DDD, lineage, or integration docs need architecture/domain/lineage/integration diagrams.
Standard structure for TSA migration strategy Markdown — waves, strangler/coexistence, cutover, rollback. Use during Migration Strategy agent and Assembler.
Shared CSA quality gate contract, scoring dimensions, severity rules, and remediation brief format. Use when Completeness Validator or Manager evaluates specialist artifacts.
Normalizes ADR/target architecture spec into a machine stack decisions object (language, DB, messaging, API, runtime). Use during TSA Intake.

Orchestrator Manager for Target State Architecture — bootstraps shared memory, runs Intake then parallel TSA specialists, gates via Completeness, assembles TSA pack. Use as primary TSA workflow orchestrator.
Shared TSA artifact metadata, CSA/ADR citation rules, and confidence bands. Use when producing or validating any TSA specialist artifact JSON.
Validates TSA specialist artifacts against schemas and gate rubrics; emits pass/fail reports. Use after every TSA specialist as Manager subagent.
Design target data architecture and migration of CSA lineage/SP logic toward ADR datastore patterns. Use when Manager invokes TSA Data.
Assembles TSA pack Markdown + arc42-C4 HTML with Mermaid, migration roadmap, and epic/story seeds from accepted TSA artifacts. Use when Manager invokes TSA Assembler.
Map CSA domains/capabilities to target bounded contexts using ADR constraints. Use when Manager invokes TSA Domain.
Ingest CSA pack + ADR/target spec; emit intake.json and stack_decisions.json. Use when Manager invokes TSA Intake.
Design target integration landscape (API/events/messaging) from ADR and CSA integration baseline. Use when Manager invokes TSA Integration.
Produce wave-based migration strategy (strangler/coexistence/cutover/rollback) from CSA gaps and TSA designs. Use when Manager invokes TSA Migration Strategy.
Shared-memory protocol for TSA Orchestrator swarm so parallel specialists sync intake, artifacts, and migration state. Use for Manager bootstrap and every TSA subagent turn.
Design target technical architecture and C4 views using ADR stack decisions and CSA baseline. Use when Manager invokes TSA Tech Architecture.
